name: SubArabify Arabic Subtitles
description: On-server EN→AR subtitles. Downloads a small Arabic NMT model once, then writes Movie.SubArabify.ar.srt next to each video with bit-identical timings. Runs on normal servers and on Android via Termux (pure Python, no .NET).
overview: Automatic Arabic subtitles for your Jellyfin library. Offline after the one-time model download. Brand cues only in free gaps — dialogue sync untouched.
changelog: 1.0.3-beta: smart chunked translation, persistent memory, timing-safe branding, Termux support, VTT input.
